scope.religion_policy: Demand conversion, take vows, kinslaying doctrine and execution-tenet branches remain part of the exact stock source hash but are not decomposed. A future observer may expose only the engine-final validity/reason result for an allowlisted nonreligious action or option.

required_tokens: Can Send: If an interaction can be sent is tested like this:

imprison_interaction.summary: Final send may proceed despite predicted rejection. Recipient answer combines intrigue, hook, legal authority, rank, dread, relative military power, rivalry and culture. Sender adds strong legal-reason value, risk and relationship suppression, struggle branches and two hard-zero states.

move_to_house_arrest_interaction.summary: No authored AI target/frequency/weight block; this is still a visible player custody transition and must not be invented as an AI policy.

ransom_interaction.summary: Sender prefers valid money after long imprisonment, adds greed, suppresses rival/nemesis, may prefer a favor from a vassal, and hard-zeroes war, recent human refusal and active prison break. Recipient acceptance is a distinct payer/prisoner relationship and dread tree.

pay_ransom_interaction.summary: Role shape redirects actor, jailer and secondary prisoner. Sender interest depends on kin/relation/compassion, payment shape, heir value and ability; invalid exchange, war/human refusal and prison break hard-zero the offer. Jailer acceptance independently scores payment, hooks, hostility, POW state and dread.

release_from_prison_interaction.priority: P0 unconditional release; P1 allowlisted nonreligious conditions
release_from_prison_interaction.summary: Unconditional release is auto-accepted only when every option is false. Nonreligious conditions have separate recipient acceptance costs and sender desirability; compassion/time-imprisoned, revenge, feud and struggle branches affect unconditional release. Active prison break hard-zeroes.

execute_prisoner_interaction.summary: Legal execution reason, sadism/lunacy, inheritance, vengeance, rivals and struggle/nomad inputs raise interest; absent a reason/rival/inheritance/lunacy the tree hard-zeroes. Kinslaying and special tenet branches are retained only under the frozen source hash and excluded from policy decomposition.

torture_interaction.summary: Sadistic, family feud and a recorded escape attempt are the three direct positive modifiers.

castrate_interaction.summary: Sadistic, family feud, escape attempt and Byzantine-punishment emulation add interest.

blind_interaction.summary: The direct AI weight shape matches castration; legality and outcome remain distinct native results.

systematically_maim_character_interactio.summary: Co-rulership and special legality make this a later slice. Sadistic, callous, feud and escape-attempt modifiers are frozen; vow semantics are excluded.

crime_and_reason_boundary.static_result: Crime is consumed by stock imprisonment/banishment/execution reason checks, tyranny effects and the final interaction validator. It is not one stable external boolean derivable from a copied list of traits or secrets.
required_native_outputs: native displayed tyranny or resource consequence where the interaction exposes it
crime_and_reason_boundary.prohibition: Do not reconstruct faith/doctrine crime classification, punishment legality, tyranny or AI acceptance in the planner.

generic_interaction_native_substrate.status: reused exact-build substrate; prisoner enumerator and ransom role/option ownership remain unimplemented

exact_build_reflection_anchors.boundary: These unique exact-build strings prove reflected query surfaces exist. They do not identify a safe native method RVA, collection ownership, or lifetime.
